label: rem:categorical-fourier-exists-harmonic
title: Projections and harmonic analysis on $A$
html: Concretely, given the family of irreducible representations (irreps), the Fourier transform provides a family of projections, each isolating the component of an endomorphism on a given irrep. This structural existence theorem underpins the harmonic analysis on the categorical Frobenius–Hopf algebra A.
